_read_me: This one file feeds the courses and the city dates on the site, in French (/) and English (/en). A text can be one line for both languages, or {"en": "...", "fr": "..."}. Dates in YYYY-MM-DD. A session or event disappears by itself the day after its last date. 'updated' is printed on the page, so change it whenever you edit. Prices only show when show_prices is true. A course with "direct": true is booked on its own site (book.url), so it gets no 'send me info' button.
